The aircraft nose gear, the entire wheel, the wedge-to-tire contact, both connected arms and the two faces remain visible together. A broad aircraft fuselage and high-mounted wing extend behind them, with a hangar door and sparse service carts farther away. Muted steel-blue dawn light meets a warm hangar spill on her cheek and the worn cotton folds. A low, unobtrusive three-quarter camera position, medium-wide horizontal frame, natural 40mm perspective and moderate depth of field connect the two workers with the equipment; documentary skin texture, quiet material wear, a grounded working moment.
